phase: Phase 1A — freeze the source registry + acquisition DAG schema. Design-only: NO source rows authored here.
spec_ref: SPEC §5 (source-first, one artifact fans out to every dependent metric; never 295 browser searches), §7.1 (acquire once per (family,dealer,period,schema_revision))

period.note: e.g. 2026-08-24..2026-08-30 or a daily date; ambiguous period is a fail-closed stop.

provenance_ref.note: Missing provenance is a fail-closed stop.

sales_only_receipt.note: Zero Service/Parts proof; else quarantine whole-delivery.

dag_invariants: The acquisition dedupe key (profile, family, period, schema_revision) is UNIQUE across source nodes: exactly one acquisition task per key.
NO per-metric duplicate acquisition: a metric that needs an already-registered (family,period,schema_revision) reuses that source_id; it does not create a second acquisition node.
Edges are strictly source -> metric (fan-out). A metric may depend on multiple sources; a source may feed many metrics.
The dependency graph is acyclic (metrics never feed acquisition).
Every dependent_metric_id is one of the frozen 295 (or a registered beyond-295 candidate, per candidate-intake schema — which is a SEPARATE registry).
acquisition_admission_state transitions obey frozen-vocabularies acquisition_admission_state (quarantine terminal; promotion only from held).
A source in acquisition_exception opens a visible source-run exception and creates no empty observations for its dependent metrics.
